vratá, n.
 —1. will; devānām ati vratam,
beyond the will of the gods, 88^2 --cf.
ὑπὲρ Διὸς αἶσαν; decree, command or
Gebot, statute; and so
 —2. (as Eng.
command is applied to the forces under
one's command) that over which one
exercises command, domain, Gebiet;--
further, directly from the root again
 —3.
choice, determination; firm resolution,
14^6;
 —4. esp. resolve (to keep a religious
or ascetic observance); vow or holy work
(e. g. of chastity, fasting, etc.), 28^23, 59^5,
61^23, 64^8, 65^8;
 —5. religious duty, duty
in general. [√2vṛ, ‘will, choose’: for
mg 2, observe that Ger. Gebiet formerly
meant ‘command’ and now means ‘domain.
’]
